commands:
set -eu
ARCHIVE=/tmp/phantom-source-snapshot-20261026T092647Z.tar.gz
EXPECTED=18f0ac9b88534e2879409037d8cabf0028fa63384c183f58b1f5a7800a44e70d
ACTUAL=$(sha256sum "$ARCHIVE" | awk '{print $1}')
echo "REMOTE_ARCHIVE_SHA256=$ACTUAL"
test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"
test ! -e /opt/phantom-ebpf
mkdir -p /opt/phantom-source-snapshots/20261026T092647Z /opt/phantom-ebpf
cp "$ARCHIVE" /opt/phantom-source-snapshots/20261026T092647Z/phantom-source-snapshot.tar.gz
chmod 600 /opt/phantom-source-snapshots/20261026T092647Z/phantom-source-snapshot.tar.gz
tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE" | awk 'BEGIN{bad=0} /^\//{bad=1} /(^|\/)\.\.(\/|$)/{bad=1} END{exit bad}'
tar -xzf "$ARCHIVE" -C /opt/phantom-ebpf
chown -R ubuntu:ubuntu /opt/phantom-ebpf
printf 'snapshot_id=20261026T092647Z\ncommit=664441fb93b08fbad33fcce9bf1b6d92d02d6a71\narchive_sha256=18f0ac9b88534e2879409037d8cabf0028fa63384c183f58b1f5a7800a44e70d\nfile_count=366\n' > /opt/phantom-source-snapshots/20261026T092647Z/snapshot-info.txt
sha256sum /opt/phantom-source-snapshots/20261026T092647Z/phantom-source-snapshot.tar.gz
echo EXTRACTED_ROOT=/opt/phantom-ebpf
if [ -f /var/log/phantom-bootstrap.done ]; then echo BOOTSTRAP_COMPLETE=yes; else echo BOOTSTRAP_COMPLETE=no; fi
kill "$(cat /tmp/phantom_snapshot_receiver_20261026.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true
